title: Case: Parcel has been routed to the wrong local depot
context: Routing acknowledges the label was sorted to the wrong local depot. Only the receiving depot can confirm the transfer’s physical completion.
initial_request: The tracker shows a depot in the wrong area. Can you get my parcel to the local depot before arranging delivery?

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the carrier routing team to transfer it to the correct depot.

must_not: Correct-depot receipt does not prove last-mile delivery.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Please transfer DL-9431 from North Sedgeglass to East Copperfin. Send the destination receipt scan, not just a planned linehaul entry.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-015: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. 36 irrelevant events turn this into a long thread; the decisive events are the seed's. The escalation arrives by Email instead of Customer portal; replying on either channel is accepted. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
